integration_make_description: Connect Make (formerly Integromat) to trigger automation scenarios when users submit feedback, when statuses change, and when comments are added.
integration_make_setup_step_1: Create a new scenario in Make and add a Webhooks module as the trigger.
integration_make_setup_step_2: Copy the webhook URL and paste it below, then click Save. Quackback will send a test payload.
integration_make_setup_step_3: Choose which events should trigger your scenario, then continue building in Make.
integration_make_disconnect_description: This will remove the Make integration and stop all webhook notifications. You can reconnect at any time.
integration_make_enabled_description: Turn off to pause all Make webhook notifications
integration_make_events_help: Choose which events trigger your Make scenario

integration_make_event_status_changed_de: When the status of a feedback post is updated
integration_make_event_comment_created_d: When someone comments on a feedback post

integration_zapier_description: Connect Zapier to trigger automated workflows when users submit feedback, when statuses change, and when comments are added.
integration_zapier_setup_step_1: Create a new Zap in Zapier and add a Webhooks by Zapier trigger with Catch Hook.
integration_zapier_setup_step_2: Copy the webhook URL from Zapier and paste it below, then click Save. Quackback will send a test payload.
integration_zapier_setup_step_3: Choose which events should trigger your Zap, then continue building your workflow in Zapier.
integration_zapier_disconnect_descriptio: This will remove the Zapier integration and stop all webhook notifications. You can reconnect at any time.

integration_n8n_description: Connect n8n to trigger automated workflows when users submit feedback, when statuses change, and when comments are added.
integration_n8n_setup_step_1: Create a new workflow in n8n and add a Webhook trigger node.
integration_n8n_setup_step_2: Copy the production webhook URL and paste it below, then click Save. Quackback will send a test payload.
integration_n8n_setup_step_3: Choose which events should trigger your workflow, then continue building in n8n.
integration_n8n_disconnect_description: This will remove the n8n integration and stop all webhook notifications. You can reconnect at any time.
integration_n8n_enabled_description: Turn off to pause all n8n webhook notifications

integration_stripe_description: Connect Stripe to enrich feedback with customer revenue data. See MRR, plan tier, and billing status alongside each feedback submission.
integration_stripe_setup_step_1: Create a restricted API key in your Stripe dashboard with read access to Customers.
integration_stripe_setup_step_2: Paste the API key below and click Save. Quackback will verify the connection.
integration_stripe_setup_step_3: Customer data will be automatically looked up by email when new feedback is submitted.
integration_stripe_disconnect_descriptio: This will remove the Stripe integration and stop all payment event synchronization. You can reconnect at any time.
integration_stripe_enabled_description: Turn off to pause all Stripe payment synchronization
integration_stripe_events_help: Choose which events trigger Stripe actions
integration_stripe_event_post_created_de: Sync payment data when users submit new feedback
integration_stripe_event_status_changed_: Update payment records when feedback status changes
integration_stripe_api_key_help: Use a restricted API key with read-only access to customer and payment data.
integration_teams_description: Connect Microsoft Teams to receive notifications when users submit feedback, when statuses change, and when comments are added.
integration_teams_setup_step_1: Register Quackback in your Azure AD tenant and add the Teams bot permissions.
integration_teams_setup_step_2: Click Connect to authorize Quackback to post to your Teams channels.
integration_teams_setup_step_3: Select a team and channel for notifications, then choose which events trigger messages.
integration_teams_disconnect_description: This will remove the Teams integration and stop all notifications. You can reconnect at any time.
integration_teams_enabled_description: Turn off to pause all Teams notifications
integration_teams_load_teams_failed: Failed to load teams. Please try again.

integration_teams_team_help: Select the Microsoft Teams team where notifications should be posted.
integration_teams_channel_help: The bot will post notifications to this channel. Make sure the bot has been added to your team.
integration_slack_setup_step_1: Click Connect to authorize Quackback to post messages to your Slack workspace.
integration_slack_setup_step_2: Select which channel notifications should be posted to. The bot must be added to private channels before they appear in the list.
integration_slack_setup_step_3: Choose which events trigger notifications. You can enable or disable individual event types at any time.
integration_coming_soon_description: This integration is on our roadmap. Check back later or let us know if you'd like to see it prioritized.
integration_zendesk_setup_step_1: Connect your Zendesk account to authorize read-only access to user and ticket data.
integration_zendesk_setup_step_2: When feedback is submitted by a known email, Quackback looks up their Zendesk profile.
integration_zendesk_setup_step_3: Support context like organization and ticket history appears alongside their feedback.

integration_zendesk_disconnect_descripti: This will remove the Zendesk integration and stop syncing support data. You can reconnect at any time.
